title: Planned standing-start reference capture for Arcade Rush sector budgets
description: M0.9 planned capture for the second BENCHMARKS reference kind: five clean standing-start single laps by the CalibrationDriver on the balanced starter at stock loadout with Standard assists, traffic-free, on the planned slice course. Arcade Rush uses the selected stock car's standing-start reference splits (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md): three intermediate timing gates plus the finish over four sectors, with initial budget factors 1.20/1.10/1.02 for Rookie/Racer/Expert and b_i = factor * reference_sector_seconds + measured_mistake_margin_i, rounded to milliseconds. The embedded record is planned and carries no results; the medal thresholds stay null because they derive from the flying-lap median, which is a different record. Rookie's margin must permit one brief mistake and Expert's must account for observed run variance; the margins themselves are measured values that do not exist yet.

scenario.title: Standing-start reference capture, balanced starter, Riviera Run
scenario.description: One calibration-driver run capturing the standing-start single-lap reference whose sector splits feed Arcade Rush budgets. Arcade Rush has one standing-start slot and is stock-only (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md). The tactical opportunity-window protocol does not apply and is omitted. The initial commands come from the pinned CalibrationDriver revision recorded in initial_state.initial_commands.

driver.note: Standing-start capture from the grid slot; acceleration takes effect at GO without a false-start penalty (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md).

initial_state.description: Standing start from the Arcade Rush slot: zero speed at GO, matching the single standing-start slot in docs/GAME_DESIGN.md.

initial_commands.note: The CalibrationDriver controller revision in dependencies produces the initial commands; acceleration takes effect at GO without a false-start penalty (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md).

seeds.note: Authored seeds; distinct from the flying-lap capture so the two reference kinds never share a seed.

reference_records.title: Planned standing-start reference record, balanced starter, Riviera Run
reference_records.description: Capture plan for the five clean standing-start single laps whose sector splits establish the Arcade Rush checkpoint budgets for the selected stock car. Results are deliberately absent until capture tooling measures them. Medal thresholds do not apply to this record: they derive from the flying-lap median of reference.balanced_starter.riviera_flying.

expectations.statement: The fixture family equals the enclosed scenario's family.
A standing-start capture omits the tactical opportunity-window members.
The scenario declares the full reference-capture telemetry minimum, including the sector splits Arcade Rush budgets are built from.
The embedded standing-start record is planned and carries no laps, statistics, hashes or thresholds.
The capture protocol rejects runs with contacts, reset, missed gates, invalid progress or numerical errors.
Every null has a matching unknowns entry; the medal thresholds are null on a standing-start record because they derive from the flying-lap median.
The Arcade Rush factors are documented initial targets, not measurements.
Every comparison metric uses the documented comparator vocabulary: threshold comparators carry a numeric value and no bounds.

Once capture tooling measures this standing-start record it must retain speed samples, the car/loadout/assist hashes and four sector splits per clean lap, because Arcade Rush budgets are built from those sector times.
The content hash recomputes over canonical JSON with the content_hash member removed.
